Storage Instructions: Unmixed medication should be stored at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store this medication in the bathroom, as the humidity can affect its stability. Medications should not be flushed down the toilet or poured into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. When the product is expired or no longer needed, dispose of it properly according to local regulations or pharmacy guidelines. Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this product and your individual health needs. Medical Monitoring: While using this medication, it is essential to undergo regular laboratory and/or medical tests, such as kidney function tests, hearing evaluations, and monitoring of streptomycin levels, to ensure safety and efficacy. Be sure to attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, it is important to take the medication as soon as possible, following the prescribed schedule.
